messages:
Jamie Ortiz: Quick design review — updated playground controls attached. Trying a compact 'mini toolkit' that surfaces Stop / Regenerate and an inline 'token peek' next to each response. Main goals: make stopping obvious, keep regen discoverable but secondary, and show token/cost details without noisy flicker. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/abc123
Lucy Chen: I like the compact look. Concern: token peek inline might overlap message copy on narrow widths. Maybe collapse into a popover (triggered by an ellipsis) on mobile? @Sanjay Patel any keyboard/aria thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sanjay Patel: We can make token peek a button with aria-expanded and role=dialog so it's tabbable. Implementation note: streaming updates will change token totals a lot — heavy DOM churn. I recommend debouncing updates client-side (200ms) or streaming only deltas.
Rachel Gomez: Agree on debounce. Microcopy suggestion: rename 'token peek' -> 'token details' — clearer to non-dev users. Accessibility: current mini chip color contrast (blue on white) is ~3:1, needs 4.5:1 for body text.
Kevin O'Neill: Research note: in prototypes users prefer an explicit 'Stop' label vs icon-only. Keep Stop as primary visible control; put Regenerate behind a secondary affordance. :white_check_mark:
Alex Mora: What if Regenerate lives in the prompt-deck/context menu (less primary)? Also propose showing estimated cost in the token details popover so users understand implications.
Jamie Ortiz: OK—plan for updated comps: 1) Stop as primary action (text label + icon); 2) Regenerate moved to prompt deck/context menu; 3) Token details as a popover with token breakdown + estimated cost + timestamp; 4) debounce stream updates. I'll push revised frames shortly.
designbot: New Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/xyz — Jamie added frames "playground/mini-toolkit/v2".
Lucy Chen: Implementation notes for eng: we'll need an API flag to stream token deltas to avoid client recomputing tokens on every chunk. @Sanjay Patel can we add something like `?token_delta_stream=true`?
Sanjay Patel: Yep — I'll add a `token_delta_stream` query flag (default false). Backend will emit `token_snapshot` events every 250ms when enabled to reduce churn. PR ETA tomorrow.
Rachel Gomez: Small ARIA nit — use full screen-reader label 'Stop generation' (not just 'Stop') on the button, and ensure dialog has `aria-label="Token details"`.
Jamie Ortiz: Thanks — I'll update labels and bump contrast. Can someone run a quick accessibility sweep after I push the new frames? @Kevin O'Neill?
Kevin O'Neill: On it — will test with VoiceOver and high-contrast mode after comps land.
Jamie Ortiz: One more product question — should Regenerate trigger a confirmation when estimated cost > 3x of the original? Risky to let users accidentally spend.
Alex Mora: I'd add a soft confirmation toast: 'Regenerate response? Estimated cost: $0.12' with 'Proceed' CTA. Not a hard block, just a friction for high-cost ops.
Sanjay Patel: I'll emit analytics events `regen_confirmed` and `regen_skipped` so we can measure how often users confirm.
Jamie Ortiz: Great, thanks everyone — I'll update the Figma and post new frames + accessibility checklist. Closing this thread once PR + comps are linked. :rocket:
